name: garmin-py
description: Garmin Connect health, activity, workout, and training data as MCP tools.
long_description: Exposes your Garmin Connect data (sleep, HRV, body battery, activities, workouts, training status, personal records, and more) to Claude as MCP tools. Enter your Garmin Connect credentials once during installation; they are stored in your operating system's keychain and used only to log in to Garmin. If your account uses multi-factor authentication, Claude will ask you for the one-time code on first use. Requires Python __GARMIN_PY_MIN_PYTHON__+ on your machine and an internet connection on first launch.

garmin_email.title: Garmin Connect email
garmin_email.description: The email address of your Garmin Connect account.

garmin_password.title: Garmin Connect password
garmin_password.description: Stored securely in your OS keychain; sent only to Garmin to log in.

garmin_file_root.title: Activity file folder
garmin_file_root.description: The only folder activity downloads are written to and uploads are read from. Must be an absolute path. Leave empty for the default, ~/Downloads/garmin-py.

garmin_read_only.title: Read-only mode
garmin_read_only.description: Hide every tool that changes Garmin data or writes files (workouts, activities, training plans).
